_about: Pregnancy facts for medicines, starting with the 24 that experts of the European Network of Teratology Information Services (ENTIS) list as known human structural teratogens (Bluett-Duncan et al., Birth Defects Res 2025;117(9):e2497, Table 1). For each: when in pregnancy the harm occurs, the dose, the effects, and the absolute risk, each with a verbatim quote from an authoritative source read for this file (regulators' product information: US FDA, EMA, ANSM, MHRA; systematic reviews; large registry or cohort studies; the ENTIS paper). Each fact was checked by two independent readers, one on the source and quote, one on overstatement, and settled by a third; a fact no source states is absent rather than guessed. Read 2 October 2026. Further medicines are documented the same way; "entis_list" names the 24 on the experts' list. "cosmetics" holds, for cosmetic ingredients, the EU limit, the dose the safety assessment rests on, the effect on development and the assessor's conclusion, from the EU Cosmetics Regulation, SCCS opinions and Cosmetic Ingredient Review reports. Read by tools/enrich-teratogens-entis.py.

entis.label: ENTIS expert list of known human structural teratogens
entis.citation: Bluett-Duncan M et al. A Scoping Review of Human Teratogens and Their Impact on the Developing Brain. Birth Defects Res. 2025;117(9):e2497
entis.quote: Twenty‐four medications were identified by experts as having structural teratogenic potential

window.text: Counted by trimester, the US label says the risk of major structural defects is greatest in the first trimester, while other serious developmental effects can occur throughout pregnancy.
window.quote: The risk of major structural abnormalities is greatest during the first trimester; however, other serious developmental effects can occur with valproate use throughout pregnancy.
window.source_label: US label, Depakote (divalproex sodium), AbbVie, section 8.1 Pregnancy, via openFDA

dose.text: The US label says the malformation risk rises with dose, but no threshold dose below which there is no risk can be established.
dose.quote: This risk is dose-dependent; however, a threshold dose below which no risk exists cannot be established.
dose.source_label: US label, Depakote (divalproex sodium), AbbVie, section 8.1 Pregnancy, via openFDA

effects.text: The US label lists neural tube defects, cardiovascular malformations, oral clefts, craniosynostosis, hypospadias and limb malformations such as clubfoot and polydactyly among major malformations reported after valproate exposure.
effects.quote: The major congenital malformations included cases of neural tube defects, cardiovascular malformations, craniofacial defects (e.g., oral clefts, craniosynostosis), hypospadias, limb malformations (e.g., clubfoot, polydactyly)
effects.source_label: US label, Depakote (divalproex sodium), AbbVie, section 8.1 Pregnancy (Human Data), via openFDA

absolute_risk.text: EMA's patient wording says that about 10 in 100 babies of women taking valproate in pregnancy have birth defects, compared with 2 to 3 in 100 babies of women without epilepsy.
absolute_risk.quote: in women who take valproate around 10 babies in every 100 will have birth defects. This compares to 2 to 3 babies in every 100 born to women who don’t have epilepsy.
absolute_risk.source_label: EMA, valproate Article 31 referral EMEA/H/A-31/1454, Annex III (package leaflet wording)

before_after.text: For women able to have children, French product information requires a negative pregnancy test before starting and at regular intervals, uninterrupted effective contraception, and, if pregnancy is planned, every effort to switch before conception.
before_after.quote: qu’elles ne soient pas enceintes (test de grossesse plasmatique d’une sensibilité d’au moins 25 mUI/ml négatif à l’instauration du traitement et à intervalles réguliers pendant le traitement)
before_after.source_label: ANSM, Depakine 500 mg comprimé gastro-résistant, RCP sections 4.4 and 4.6 (base de données publique des médicaments)

paternal.text: As a precaution against a possible neurodevelopmental risk to children, the MHRA advises men to use condoms plus partner contraception, and not to donate sperm, during valproate treatment and for 3 months after stopping.
paternal.quote: as a precaution, recommend that male patients use effective contraception (condoms, plus contraception used by the female sexual partner) throughout the valproate treatment period and for 3 months after stopping valproate
paternal.source_label: MHRA Drug Safety Update, 'Valproate use in men: as a precaution, men and their partners should use effective contraception'
paternal.id: Drug Safety Update volume 18, issue 2, September 2024

other_effects.text: French product information says studies show up to 30 to 40% of preschool children exposed in utero to valproate monotherapy have early developmental delays, such as late speech and walking.
other_effects.quote: Lorsque le valproate est administré en monothérapie, les études menées chez des enfants d'âge préscolaire exposés in utero au valproate montrent que jusqu'à 30 à 40 % d'entre eux présentent des retards de développement dans la petite enfance
other_effects.source_label: ANSM, Depakine 500 mg comprimé gastro-résistant, RCP section 4.6 (base de données publique des médicaments)

regulatory.text: Since a 2018 EU-wide decision, valproate is contraindicated in girls and women able to have children unless a pregnancy prevention programme is followed, and in pregnancy unless, for epilepsy, no other effective treatment exists.
regulatory.quote: Valproate medicines are now therefore contraindicated, i.e. must not be used, in girls and women able to have children unless the terms of a special pregnancy prevention programme are followed.
regulatory.source_label: EMA, valproate and related substances Article 31 referral EMEA/H/A-31/1454, referral page (overview and information for patients and healthcare professionals)

monitoring.text: For exposed pregnancies, French product information requires specialised prenatal monitoring for neural tube and other defects, maternal and newborn clotting tests around birth, and close follow-up of the child's neurodevelopment.
monitoring.quote: une surveillance prénatale spécialisée doit être instaurée en vue de détecter d’éventuelles anomalies touchant le tube neural ou d’autres malformations
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, Depakine 500 mg comprimé gastro-résistant, RCP section 4.6 (base de données publique des médicaments)

evidence_base.text: A 2023 Cochrane systematic review pooled 3,018 valproate-exposed children from 31 cohort studies and 1,364 from six health-record studies, all observational, finding major malformations in 9.8% and 9.7%.
evidence_base.quote: The prevalence of major malformations (any type) in cohort studies for children exposed to valproate (VPA) (N = 3018), based on data from 31 studies, was 9.8% (95% CI 8.1 to 11.9).
evidence_base.source_label: Bromley et al., Monotherapy treatment of epilepsy in pregnancy: congenital malformation outcomes in the child, Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2023, Results (valproate)

dose.text: In EURAP, major malformations rose with the dose taken at conception, from 4.6% at 700 mg a day or less to 5.9% above 700 up to 1,000 mg and 9.1% above 1,000 mg.
dose.source_label: Battino et al. (EURAP), JAMA Neurol 2024;81(5):481-489, Table 2 (CC-BY)

effects.text: The French product information lists neural tube defects (spina bifida), craniofacial defects including cleft lip or palate, cardiovascular malformations, hypospadias, finger hypoplasia and microcephaly among the most frequent malformations.
effects.quote: Les malformations les plus souvent rencontrées sont des anomalies du tube neural (spina bifida), des anomalies crânio-faciales (dont les fentes labiales/palatines), des malformations cardiovasculaires, des hypospadias, une hypoplasie des doigts, une microcéphalie
effects.source_label: ANSM, Tegretol 200 mg comprimé sécable, RCP section 4.6 (base de données publique des médicaments, page last updated 29/09/2026)

absolute_risk.text: In the US label, the North American registry found major malformations in 3.0% of 1,033 first-trimester exposures to carbamazepine alone, a relative risk of 2.7 (95% CI 1.0 to 7.0) versus no antiepileptic drug.
absolute_risk.quote: major congenital malformations of 3.0% [...] among pregnant females exposed to carbamazepine monotherapy (n=1,033) during the first trimester with a relative risk of 2.7 (95% CI: 1.0, 7.0) compared to pregnant females not taking an epileptic drug
absolute_risk.source_label: US label, Equetro (carbamazepine), Validus, section 8.1 Pregnancy (Human Data, NAAED Pregnancy Registry), via openFDA

before_after.text: French product information says a pregnancy test should be considered before starting, and effective contraception is needed during treatment and until two weeks after stopping, as hormonal contraceptives may fail.
before_after.quote: Les femmes susceptibles de procréer doivent utiliser une contraception efficace pendant le traitement et jusqu’à deux semaines après l’arrêt du traitement.
before_after.source_label: ANSM, Tegretol 200 mg comprimé sécable, RCP sections 4.4 and 4.6 (base de données publique des médicaments)

other_effects.text: French product information says a Nordic registry study suggests more small-for-gestational-age births (12.8% versus 10.9% for children of untreated women with epilepsy), and that neurodevelopmental studies are contradictory and cannot exclude a risk.
other_effects.quote: Le risque de PAG chez les enfants de femmes épileptiques traitées par carbamazépine était de 12,8 %, contre 10,9 % chez les enfants de femmes épileptiques ne recevant pas de traitement antiépileptique.
other_effects.source_label: ANSM, Tegretol 200 mg comprimé sécable, RCP section 4.6 (base de données publique des médicaments)

regulatory.text: Since 2025 in France, girls, women who could become pregnant and pregnant women must show the pharmacist, with the prescription, an information form co-signed yearly with their doctor to obtain carbamazepine.
regulatory.quote: Pour dispenser ce médicament à une fille, une adolescente, une femme susceptible d’avoir des enfants ou enceinte, la patiente doit vous présenter, en plus de l’ordonnance, l’attestation d’information partagée signée chaque année par elle et le médecin.
regulatory.source_label: ANSM news, 'Carbamazépine et grossesse : renforcement de l'information des femmes', information for pharmacists (published 13/12/2024, updated 27/03/2025)

monitoring.text: French product information recommends specialised prenatal monitoring for malformations and growth restriction, folic acid before and during pregnancy and, if treatment continues, monotherapy at the lowest effective dose with plasma-level monitoring.
monitoring.quote: Une surveillance prénatale spécialisée de ces malformations et du retard de croissance est recommandée.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, Tegretol 200 mg comprimé sécable, RCP section 4.6 (base de données publique des médicaments)

evidence_base.text: A 2023 Cochrane systematic review pooled 5,415 carbamazepine-exposed children from 37 cohort studies and 2,806 from five health-record studies, all observational, finding major malformations in 4.7% and 4.0%.
evidence_base.quote: The prevalence of major malformations (any type) in the cohort studies for children exposed to carbamazepine (CBZ) (N = 5415), based on data from 37 studies, was 4.7% (95% CI 3.7 to 5.9).
evidence_base.source_label: Bromley et al., Monotherapy treatment of epilepsy in pregnancy: congenital malformation outcomes in the child, Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2023, Results (carbamazepine)

window.text: The French product information says a particular syndrome is suggested with hydantoin use, such as phenytoin, in the first trimester; it gives no window in weeks.
window.quote: Un syndrome particulier est évoqué pour la prise d'hydantoïnes au premier trimestre.
window.source_label: ANSM, DI-HYDAN 100 mg (phenytoin) RCP, section 4.6

dose.text: The UK medicines regulator judged the data on dose inconsistent and too limited to conclude whether phenytoin's malformation risk depends on dose.
dose.quote: Overall, these data are inconsistent and too limited to draw conclusions on a dose-dependent risk of congenital malformations following phenytoin exposure in utero.
dose.source_label: MHRA / Commission on Human Medicines, Public Assessment Report: antiepileptic drugs, review of safety of use during pregnancy, section 3.7

effects.text: The US label says more major malformations, such as clefts and heart defects, and fetal hydantoin syndrome features, including nail and digit hypoplasia, microcephaly and cognitive deficits, have been reported.
effects.quote: Increased frequencies of major malformations (such as orofacial clefts and cardiac defects), and abnormalities characteristic of fetal hydantoin syndrome, including dysmorphic skull and facial features, nail and digit hypoplasia, growth abnormalities (including microcephaly), and cognitive deficits, have been reported
effects.source_label: US FDA label, Dilantin Infatabs (phenytoin), Pfizer, section 5.13 (via openFDA)

absolute_risk.text: The UK medicines regulator says the data support that around 6 in 100 children exposed to phenytoin alone in pregnancy have a malformation, against 2 to 3 in 100 generally.
absolute_risk.quote: around 6% of children exposed to phenytoin monotherapy during pregnancy suffer from congenital malformations; this risk is increased compared with that in children of mothers who were not exposed to antiepileptics during pregnancy (2-3% in the general population)
absolute_risk.source_label: MHRA / Commission on Human Medicines, Public Assessment Report: antiepileptic drugs, review of safety of use during pregnancy, key findings for phenytoin

before_after.text: EU regulators say a pregnancy test should be considered before starting oral phenytoin, and women who could become pregnant should use effective contraception during treatment and for one month after stopping.
before_after.quote: Pregnancy testing in women of childbearing potential should be considered prior to initiating treatment with X. Women of childbearing potential should use effective contraception during treatment and for one month after stopping treatment.
before_after.source_label: EMA/CMDh, phenytoin PSUSA: scientific conclusions and amendments to the product information, Annex II, SmPC section 4.6 (oral phenytoin products)

other_effects.text: The UK regulator says that, although clinical studies report inconsistent findings, the totality of the data shows a possible adverse effect of phenytoin on the child's neurodevelopment.
other_effects.quote: for phenobarbital and phenytoin, although the clinical studies report inconsistent findings, the totality of the data show the possibility of adverse effects on neurodevelopment
other_effects.source_label: MHRA, Drug Safety Update vol. 14 issue 6: Antiepileptic drugs in pregnancy, updated advice following comprehensive safety review

regulatory.text: Under a 2021 EU agreement, oral phenytoin product information says it should not be used in women of childbearing potential unless, after careful consideration of alternatives, the benefit is judged to outweigh the risks.
regulatory.quote: X should not be used in women of childbearing potential unless the benefit is judged to outweigh the risks following careful consideration of alternative suitable treatment options.
regulatory.source_label: EMA/CMDh, phenytoin PSUSA: CMDh position (agreement adopted at the April 2021 CMDh meeting), Annex II, SmPC section 4.4 (oral phenytoin products)

monitoring.text: If phenytoin must continue in pregnancy, the French product information requires specialised prenatal monitoring aimed at the described malformations, with the same screening whether or not the woman took folic acid.
monitoring.quote: une surveillance prénatale spécialisée orientée sur les malformations décrites ci-dessus doit être instaurée. Le dépistage des malformations sera identique que la patiente ait reçu ou non de l'acide folique.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, DI-HYDAN 100 mg (phenytoin) RCP, section 4.6

evidence_base.text: The UK regulator's review rests on clinical studies, including meta-analyses and pregnancy registries, of more than 2,000 phenytoin-exposed pregnancies, around 1,000 of them exposed in the first trimester.
evidence_base.quote: Clinical studies involving more than 2,000 pregnancies exposed to phenytoin, including around 1,000 pregnancies exposed in the first trimester, show an increased risk of major congenital malformations following prenatal phenytoin exposure
evidence_base.source_label: MHRA / Commission on Human Medicines, Public Assessment Report: antiepileptic drugs, review of safety of use during pregnancy, section 3.7

effects.text: The US fosphenytoin label says more major malformations, such as clefts and heart defects, and fetal hydantoin syndrome features, including nail and digit hypoplasia, have been reported with phenytoin, its active metabolite.
effects.quote: Increased frequencies of major malformations (such as orofacial clefts and cardiac defects), and abnormalities characteristic of fetal hydantoin syndrome, including dysmorphic skull and facial features, nail and digit hypoplasia, growth abnormalities (including microcephaly), and cognitive deficits, have been reported
effects.source_label: US FDA label, CEREBYX (fosphenytoin sodium), Pfizer, section 5.15 (via openFDA)

absolute_risk.text: The French fosphenytoin product information says phenytoin exposure in pregnancy is associated with a major malformation rate 2 to 3 times higher than the general population's rate of 2 to 3 in 100.
absolute_risk.quote: l’exposition à la phénytoïne au cours de la grossesse est associée à une fréquence de malformations majeures 2 à 3 fois plus élevée que celle de la population générale, dont la fréquence est de 2 à 3 %
absolute_risk.source_label: ANSM, PRODILANTIN 75 mg/mL (fosphenytoin) RCP, section 4.6

before_after.text: The French fosphenytoin product information says women of childbearing potential must use effective contraception during treatment, and a pregnancy test should be considered before starting.
before_after.quote: Les femmes en âge de procréer doivent utiliser une méthode contraceptive efficace pendant le traitement. Une recherche de grossesse doit être envisagée chez les femmes en âge de procréer avant l’instauration d’un traitement par PRODILANTIN.
before_after.source_label: ANSM, PRODILANTIN 75 mg/mL (fosphenytoin) RCP, section 4.6

other_effects.text: The French fosphenytoin product information says studies of neurodevelopmental risk in children exposed to phenytoin during pregnancy are contradictory and the risk cannot be excluded.
other_effects.quote: Les études liées au risque neurodéveloppemental chez les enfants exposés à la phénytoïne pendant la grossesse sont contradictoires et le risque ne peut être exclu.
other_effects.source_label: ANSM, PRODILANTIN 75 mg/mL (fosphenytoin) RCP, section 4.6

regulatory.text: The French fosphenytoin (PRODILANTIN) product information says it must not be used in women of childbearing potential, women planning a pregnancy or pregnant women, except in case of clinical need.
regulatory.quote: PRODILANTIN ne doit pas être utilisé chez les femmes en âge de procréer, les femmes qui planifient une grossesse et les femmes enceintes, sauf en cas de besoin clinique.
regulatory.source_label: ANSM, PRODILANTIN 75 mg/mL (fosphenytoin) RCP, section 4.6

monitoring.text: If fosphenytoin is continued in pregnancy after careful benefit-risk reassessment, the French product information recommends the lowest effective dose and an adapted prenatal follow-up aimed at the described malformations.
monitoring.quote: Si après réévaluation attentive du bénéfice/risque, le traitement par PRODILANTIN est poursuivi pendant la grossesse, il est recommandé d'utiliser la dose minimale efficace et d’instaurer un suivi prénatal adapté, orienté sur la survenue éventuelle des malformations décrites.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, PRODILANTIN 75 mg/mL (fosphenytoin) RCP, section 4.6

evidence_base.text: The US fosphenytoin label takes its human evidence from phenytoin, the active metabolite, citing meta-analyses of observational studies and registries that estimate an approximately 2.4-fold increased risk of any major malformation.
evidence_base.quote: Meta-analyses using data from published observational studies and registries have estimated an approximately 2.4-fold increased risk for any major malformation in children with prenatal phenytoin exposure compared to controls.
evidence_base.source_label: US FDA label, CEREBYX (fosphenytoin sodium), Pfizer, section 8.1 (via openFDA)

window.text: The North American registry measured the malformation risk in babies whose mothers took phenobarbital during the first trimester of pregnancy (counting basis: trimester).
window.quote: The risk of major malformations was estimated among infants exposed to specific ASMs in monotherapy during the first trimester of pregnancy.
window.source_label: Hernandez-Diaz et al. (North American AED Pregnancy Registry), Neurology 2025;105(3):e213786

dose.text: The UK regulator concluded that the higher malformation risk with phenobarbital is dose-dependent but that no dose has been found to be without risk.
dose.quote: the increased risk seen with carbamazepine, phenobarbital and topiramate is dose-dependent but no dose has been found to be without risk
dose.source_label: MHRA UK Public Assessment Report, Antiepileptic drugs: review of safety of use during pregnancy (Key conclusions)

effects.text: Phenobarbital alone is associated with a higher risk of cleft lip and palate and heart defects, and hypospadias, facial dysmorphism, neural tube effects, microcephaly and finger malformations (limb/digit flag) have also been reported.
effects.quote: les fentes labiales et palatines et les malformations cardiovasculaires. D'autres malformations impliquant divers systèmes de l’organisme, notamment des cas d'hypospadias, des caractéristiques faciales dysmorphiques, des effets sur le tube neural, une dysmorphie crâniofaciale (microcéphalie) et des malformations des doigts
effects.source_label: ANSM, RCP GARDENAL 100 mg comprimé (phénobarbital), section 4.6

absolute_risk.text: The UK regulator states that most studies support malformations in 5 to 6 in 100 children exposed to phenobarbital alone, against 2 to 3 in 100 in the general population.
absolute_risk.quote: most individual studies support that 5-6% of children exposed to phenobarbital monotherapy during pregnancy suffer from congenital malformations. This risk is increased compared with children of mothers who were not exposed to antiepileptics during pregnancy (2-3% in general population)
absolute_risk.source_label: MHRA UK Public Assessment Report, Antiepileptic drugs: review of safety of use during pregnancy (Key findings for phenobarbital)

before_after.text: The French label says women of childbearing potential must use effective contraception during phenobarbital treatment and for 2 months after the last dose, and a pregnancy test should be considered before starting.
before_after.quote: Les femmes en âge de procréer doivent utiliser une contraception efficace pendant le traitement et pendant 2 mois après la dernière prise.
before_after.source_label: ANSM, RCP GARDENAL 100 mg comprimé (phénobarbital), sections 4.4 and 4.6

other_effects.text: The UK regulator concluded that, although human studies are inconsistent, the data taken with animal (non-clinical) studies support possible adverse effects of phenobarbital on the child's neurodevelopment.
other_effects.quote: for phenobarbital and phenytoin, although the clinical studies report inconsistent findings, considering these alongside the non-clinical studies which demonstrate a possible effect, the totality of the data support the possibility of adverse effects on neurodevelopment
other_effects.source_label: MHRA UK Public Assessment Report, Antiepileptic drugs: review of safety of use during pregnancy (Key conclusions)

regulatory.text: The French label says phenobarbital must not be used in women of childbearing potential unless the potential benefit is judged to outweigh the risks after other suitable treatment options are assessed.
regulatory.quote: Le phénobarbital ne doit pas être utilisé chez les femmes en âge de procréer à moins que le bénéfice potentiel ne soit jugé supérieur aux risques après évaluation des autres options thérapeutiques appropriées.
regulatory.source_label: ANSM, RCP GARDENAL 100 mg comprimé (phénobarbital), section 4.4

monitoring.text: When phenobarbital is used in pregnancy, the French label requires specialised prenatal monitoring aimed at the malformations it describes, such as clefts and heart defects.
monitoring.quote: Une surveillance prénatale spécialisée orientée sur les malformations décrites ci-dessus doit être instaurée.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, RCP GARDENAL 100 mg comprimé (phénobarbital), section 4.6

evidence_base.text: On congenital malformations, the UK regulator's review drew on three meta-analyses and other epidemiological studies involving around 1,800 phenobarbital-exposed pregnancies, including 600 exposed in the first trimester.
evidence_base.quote: These clinical studies, involving around 1800 pregnancies exposed to phenobarbital (including 600 pregnancies exposed in the first trimester), show an increased risk of major congenital malformations following phenobarbital exposure
evidence_base.source_label: MHRA UK Public Assessment Report, Antiepileptic drugs: review of safety of use during pregnancy (section 3.6 Phenobarbital, Congenital malformations)

window.text: The French product information says use in the third trimester may cause withdrawal symptoms in the newborn, such as sedation, low muscle tone and poor sucking (counting basis: trimester).
window.quote: En cas d'utilisation au cours du troisième trimestre de la grossesse, des symptômes de sevrage peuvent survenir chez le nouveau-né, notamment une sédation, une hypotonie et un trouble de la succion.
window.source_label: ANSM, RCP MYSOLINE 250 mg comprimé sécable (primidone), section 4.6

dose.text: Under a heading on the risks of primidone and of phenobarbital, its main metabolite, the French label says the malformation risk is dose-dependent and that no dose has proved risk-free.
dose.quote: Le risque est dose-dépendant ; cependant, aucune dose ne s'est avérée dépourvue de risque.
dose.source_label: ANSM, RCP MYSOLINE 250 mg comprimé sécable (primidone), section 4.6

effects.text: The French primidone label says phenobarbital alone is associated with cleft lip and palate and heart defects, with hypospadias, neural tube effects, microcephaly and digit anomalies (limb/digit flag) also reported.
effects.quote: de fentes labiales et palatines, et de malformations cardiovasculaires. D'autres malformations impliquant divers systèmes corporels ont également été signalées : notamment des cas d'hypospadias, de dysmorphies faciales, d'effets sur le tube neural, de dysmorphies cranio-faciales (microcéphalie) et d'anomalies digitales.
effects.source_label: ANSM, RCP MYSOLINE 250 mg comprimé sécable (primidone), section 4.6

absolute_risk.text: A Cochrane review found malformations in 7.9% of primidone-exposed children in pooled cohort data (95% CI 2.6% to 21.5%), but calls this evidence, from 112 pregnancies, extremely limited and urges caution.
absolute_risk.quote: Evidence pertaining to PRM was extremely limited to 112 pregnancies and caution is warranted when interpreting results. Pooled data from included cohort studies gave a malformation prevalence of 7.9% (95% CI 2.6 to 21.5%).
absolute_risk.source_label: Bromley et al., Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2023;8:CD010224 (Monotherapy treatment of epilepsy in pregnancy), Discussion

before_after.text: The French label says women of childbearing potential must use highly effective contraception during primidone treatment and for 2 months after the last dose, and a pregnancy test should be considered before starting.
before_after.quote: Les femmes en âge de procréer doivent utiliser une méthode contraceptive hautement efficace pendant le traitement et pendant 2 mois après la dernière prise.
before_after.source_label: ANSM, RCP MYSOLINE 250 mg comprimé sécable (primidone), sections 4.4 and 4.6

paternal.text: The French patient leaflet tells men and women of childbearing age to use effective contraception during treatment and until 2 months after stopping, although the prescriber's summary addresses contraception for women only.
paternal.quote: Si vous êtes un homme ou une femme en âge d’avoir des enfants, sous devez utiliser une contraception efficace pendant et jusqu’à 2 mois après l’arrêt du traitement.
paternal.source_label: ANSM, Notice MYSOLINE 250 mg comprimé sécable (primidone), section 2, Avertissements et précautions

other_effects.text: The French primidone label says studies of neurodevelopmental disorders in children exposed in pregnancy to phenobarbital, primidone's main metabolite, are contradictory and a risk cannot be excluded.
other_effects.quote: Les études relatives au risque de troubles du développement neurologique chez les enfants exposés au phénobarbital pendant la grossesse sont contradictoires, et un risque ne peut être exclu.
other_effects.source_label: ANSM, RCP MYSOLINE 250 mg comprimé sécable (primidone), section 4.6

regulatory.text: The French label says primidone must not be used in women of childbearing potential or pregnant women unless the potential benefit is judged to outweigh the risks after other suitable options are assessed.
regulatory.quote: La primidone ne doit pas être utilisée chez les femmes en âge de procréer et les femmes enceintes, sauf si le bénéfice potentiel est jugé supérieur aux risques, après évaluation des autres options thérapeutiques appropriées.
regulatory.source_label: ANSM, RCP MYSOLINE 250 mg comprimé sécable (primidone), section 4.4

monitoring.text: The US Mysoline label says pregnant women on anticonvulsant therapy, including primidone, should receive prophylactic vitamin K1 for 1 month before, and during, delivery.
monitoring.quote: Pregnant women under anticonvulsant therapy should receive prophylactic vitamin K1 therapy for 1 month prior to, and during, delivery.
monitoring.source_label: US FDA label, MYSOLINE (primidone) tablets, NDA009170, Warnings: Pregnancy (openFDA, effective 2026-09-10)

evidence_base.text: A Cochrane systematic review found data on only 112 primidone-exposed children, from seven cohort studies, with 7.9% major malformations (95% CI 2.6% to 21.5%).
evidence_base.quote: The prevalence of major malformations (any type) in cohort studies for children exposed to primidone (PRM) (N = 112), based on data from seven studies, was 7.9% (95% CI 2.6 to 21.5)
evidence_base.source_label: Bromley et al., Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2023;8:CD010224 (Monotherapy treatment of epilepsy in pregnancy), Results: Primidone

window.text: The FDA label says the oral clefts linked to topiramate occur in the first trimester, and small-for-age babies were more common when use continued until later in pregnancy.
window.quote: Because of the risk of oral clefts to the fetus, which occur in the first trimester of pregnancy, all women of childbearing potential should be informed of the potential risk to the fetus from exposure to topiramate.
window.source_label: US FDA label, Topamax (Janssen), section 8.1 Pregnancy, Clinical Considerations

dose.text: EMA states that the malformation risk has been reported to rise with dose, and that effects were observed at all doses.
dose.quote: The risk has been reported to be dose dependent; effects were observed in all doses.
dose.source_label: EMA, topiramate Article 31 referral, Annex III (agreed SmPC section 4.6 wording), CMDh position 11 October 2023

effects.text: EMA lists cleft lip or palate, hypospadias and malformations of other body systems, and also reports low birth weight, small size for age and a possible rise in neurodevelopmental disorders.
effects.quote: An increased risk of congenital malformations (particularly cleft lip/palate, hypospadias, and anomalies involving various body systems) following exposure during the first trimester.
effects.source_label: EMA, topiramate Article 31 referral, Annex III (agreed SmPC section 4.6 wording), CMDh position 11 October 2023

absolute_risk.text: In the North American registry, 4.3 in 100 babies exposed to topiramate alone had a major birth defect, against 1.4 in 100 in a group not taking antiseizure medicines.
absolute_risk.quote: The North American Antiepileptic Drug pregnancy registry data for topiramate monotherapy showed an approximate 3-fold higher prevalence of major congenital malformations (4.3%), compared with a reference group not taking AEDs (1.4%).
absolute_risk.source_label: EMA, topiramate Article 31 referral, Annex III (agreed SmPC section 4.6 wording), CMDh position 11 October 2023

before_after.text: For women who can become pregnant, the UK regulator requires a negative pregnancy test before starting and highly effective contraception throughout treatment and for at least 4 weeks after the last dose.
before_after.quote: discuss with them the need to use highly effective contraception throughout treatment and for at least four weeks after the last dose of topiramate
before_after.source_label: MHRA Drug Safety Update vol. 17 issue 11, Topiramate (Topamax): introduction of new safety measures, including a Pregnancy Prevention Programme (Advice for prescribers)

other_effects.text: Beyond malformations, EMA says topiramate can cause foetal growth restriction, and some data suggest a higher risk of neurodevelopmental disorders while other data do not.
other_effects.quote: Some data suggest an increased risk of neurodevelopmental disorders in children exposed to topiramate in utero, while other data do not suggest such an increased risk
other_effects.source_label: EMA, topiramate Article 31 referral (EMEA/H/A-31/1520), Annex III: agreed product-information wording, CMDh position (SmPC section 4.4)

regulatory.text: ANSM contraindicates topiramate in pregnancy and in women who could conceive without highly effective contraception, with two epilepsy-only exceptions; dispensing to them, pregnant women and girls requires an annual co-signed attestation.
regulatory.quote: Médicament nécessitant une surveillance particulière pendant le traitement : la prescription initiale annuelle nécessite la signature par le médecin et la patiente de l’attestation d’information partagée. La délivrance nécessite la présentation de l’attestation annuelle co-signée.
regulatory.source_label: ANSM, RCP EPITOMAX 100 mg comprimé pelliculé (topiramate), sections 4.3 and 4.6 and Conditions de prescription et de délivrance, updated 18/09/2025

monitoring.text: For epilepsy, EMA says that if topiramate is used in pregnancy, the woman should be referred to a specialist for evaluation and counselling, with careful prenatal monitoring.
monitoring.quote: If topiramate is used during pregnancy, the patient should be referred to a specialist for evaluation and counselling regarding the exposed pregnancy. Careful prenatal monitoring should be performed.
monitoring.source_label: EMA, topiramate Article 31 referral (EMEA/H/A-31/1520), Annex III: agreed product-information wording, CMDh position (SmPC section 4.6, indication epilepsy)

evidence_base.text: A 2023 Cochrane review pooled 510 topiramate-exposed children from eight cohort studies and found major malformations in 3.9% of them.
evidence_base.quote: The prevalence of major malformations (any type) in cohort studies for children exposed to topiramate (TPM) (N = 510), based on data from eight studies, was 3.9% (95% CI 2.3 to 6.5).
evidence_base.source_label: Bromley R et al., Monotherapy treatment of epilepsy in pregnancy: congenital malformation outcomes in the child, Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2023;8:CD010224

window.text: ANSM says a threefold higher risk of malformations has been reported after first-trimester exposure, and that a low dose used to induce labour at term carries no malformation risk.
window.quote: un risque de malformations fœtales multiplié par trois (incluant le syndrome de Moebius, la maladie des brides amniotiques et des anomalies du système nerveux central) a été rapporté lors de grossesses exposées au misoprostol au cours du premier trimestre.
window.source_label: ANSM, Angusta 25 microgrammes (misoprostol) RCP section 4.6, updated 09/08/2024

effects.text: The US label cites literature reports linking first-trimester misoprostol with skull defects, cranial nerve palsies, facial malformations and limb defects, and warns it can cause abortion and premature birth.
effects.quote: Several reports in the literature associate the use of misoprostol during the first trimester of pregnancy with skull defects, cranial nerve palsies, facial malformations, and limb defects.
effects.source_label: US FDA label, Cytotec (Pfizer), Pregnancy: Teratogenic effects, and boxed warning

absolute_risk.text: ANSM says pregnancies that continued after a failed abortion with mifepristone and misoprostol, or misoprostol alone, were associated with a threefold higher malformation risk, against about 2 in 100 in controls.
absolute_risk.quote: a été associé à une augmentation par 3 du risque de malformations congénitales dans le cas de grossesses évolutives exposées à la mifépristone et au misoprostol ou au misoprostol seul, comparé au groupe contrôle (environ 2%)
absolute_risk.source_label: ANSM, Gymiso 200 microgrammes (misoprostol) RCP section 4.6, updated 23/12/2025

before_after.text: For NSAID-ulcer prevention, the US label requires a negative serum pregnancy test within 2 weeks before starting and effective contraception, and advises avoiding pregnancy for at least one month or one cycle after stopping.
before_after.quote: It is also important to avoid pregnancy while taking this medication and for at least one month or through one menstrual cycle after you stop taking it.
before_after.source_label: US FDA label, Cytotec (Pfizer), boxed warning and Patient Information leaflet

other_effects.text: Beyond birth defects, the US label warns misoprostol in pregnancy can cause abortion, premature birth or uterine rupture, and, in obstetric use, fetal bradycardia and fetal death have been reported.
other_effects.quote: CYTOTEC (MISOPROSTOL) ADMINISTRATION TO WOMEN WHO ARE PREGNANT CAN CAUSE BIRTH DEFECTS, ABORTION, PREMATURE BIRTH OR UTERINE RUPTURE.
other_effects.source_label: US FDA label, Cytotec (Pfizer), boxed warning and Labor and delivery

regulatory.text: The US label carries a boxed warning, contraindicates use by pregnant women to prevent NSAID ulcers, and allows use in women of childbearing potential only at high ulcer risk and under set conditions.
regulatory.quote: Cytotec should not be taken by pregnant women to reduce the risk of ulcers induced by nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs).
regulatory.source_label: US FDA label, Cytotec (Pfizer), boxed warning and Contraindications

monitoring.text: ANSM says that if a woman continues the pregnancy after a failed abortion, a specialised centre should follow it with prenatal ultrasound paying particular attention to the limbs and head.
monitoring.quote: Si la patiente désire poursuivre sa grossesse, un suivi attentif de la grossesse avec échographie prénatale portant une attention particulière aux membres et à la tête, doit être mise en place dans un centre spécialisé.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, RCP GYMISO 200 microgrammes comprimé (misoprostol), section 4.6, updated 23/12/2025

evidence_base.text: A 2006 meta-analysis of misoprostol and birth defects pooled four case-control studies with 4,899 cases of congenital anomalies and 5,742 controls.
evidence_base.quote: Four studies involving 4899 cases of congenital anomalies and 5742 controls were included in accordance with the selection criteria.
evidence_base.source_label: da Silva Dal Pizzol T, Knop FP, Mengue SS. Prenatal exposure to misoprostol and congenital anomalies: systematic review and meta-analysis. Reprod Toxicol 2006;22(4):666-71

window.text: Malformations were described mostly after exposure between 6 and 9 weeks of pregnancy, counted from the first day of the last period (weeks of amenorrhoea).
window.quote: un syndrome malformatif a été décrit dans environ 4 % à 7 % des grossesses exposées le plus souvent entre 6 et 9 semaines d'aménorrhée.
window.source_label: ANSM, Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit, COUMADINE 5 mg (warfarine), section 4.6, updated 01/12/2022

dose.text: In small studies of women with mechanical heart valves, foetal adverse events appear to rise with first-trimester warfarin above 5 mg a day, but can also occur at 5 mg or less.
dose.quote: Thus, while it appears that foetal adverse events increase when the dose of warfarin is >5 mg/day, foetal loss and adverse events can occur in women with doses of warfarin ≤5 mg/day.
dose.source_label: D'Souza et al., Anticoagulation for pregnant women with mechanical heart valves: a systematic review and meta-analysis, Eur Heart J 2017;38(19):1509-1516 (Discussion)

effects.text: ENTIS experts list multiple malformations including an underdeveloped nose, stippled bone ends, skeletal and finger or toe (digital) defects, with reduced growth and facial differences.
effects.quote: Multiple malformations including nasal hypoplasia, stippled epiphyses, skeletal and digital. Growth disruption. Facial dysmorphia.
effects.source_label: ENTIS consensus, Bluett-Duncan et al., Birth Defects Res 2025;117(9):e2497, Table 1 (one cell spanning acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin)

absolute_risk.text: First-trimester warfarin exposure caused the malformation pattern in about 5% of exposed babies; the label says this is not an adequate basis for comparison with the 2–4% US background rate.
absolute_risk.quote: Exposure to warfarin during the first trimester of pregnancy caused a pattern of congenital malformations in about 5% of exposed offspring.
absolute_risk.source_label: US FDA label, Warfarin Sodium tablets (Teva), section 8.1 Pregnancy, effective 2025-06-17

before_after.text: The US label asks prescribers to verify pregnancy status before starting warfarin and to advise effective contraception during treatment and for at least 1 month after the last dose.
before_after.quote: Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment and for at least 1 month after the final dose of warfarin sodium.
before_after.source_label: US FDA label, Warfarin Sodium tablets (Teva), section 8.3 Females and Males of Reproductive Potential, effective 2025-06-17

other_effects.text: The US label states that intellectual disability ('mental retardation'), blindness, schizencephaly, microcephaly, hydrocephalus and other adverse outcomes have been reported after warfarin exposure in the second and third trimesters.
other_effects.quote: Mental retardation, blindness, schizencephaly, microcephaly, hydrocephalus, and other adverse pregnancy outcomes have been reported following warfarin exposure during the second and third trimesters of pregnancy
other_effects.source_label: US FDA label, Warfarin Sodium tablets (Teva), section 8.1 Pregnancy, Fetal/Neonatal Adverse Reactions, effective 2025-06-17

regulatory.text: The US label contraindicates warfarin in pregnancy except for women with mechanical heart valves at high risk of thromboembolism; its boxed warning concerns bleeding, not pregnancy.
regulatory.quote: Warfarin sodium is contraindicated in women who are pregnant except in pregnant women with mechanical heart valves, who are at high risk of thromboembolism
regulatory.source_label: US FDA label, Warfarin Sodium tablets (Teva), section 4 Contraindications (boxed warning: bleeding risk), effective 2025-06-17

monitoring.text: If Coumadine is used in pregnancy or pregnancy is discovered on treatment, the French label requires specialised prenatal diagnosis by ultrasound, or even MRI, adapted to the period of exposure.
monitoring.quote: la patiente doit être pleinement informée des risques pour le fœtus et un diagnostic prénatal spécialisé (échographique voire IRM) adapté en fonction de la période d'exposition doit être instauré
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit, COUMADINE 5 mg (warfarine), section 4.6, updated 01/12/2022

evidence_base.text: A 2017 meta-analysis found no randomised trials; 30 non-randomised studies (1,373 pregnancies) used vitamin K antagonists throughout pregnancy in women with mechanical heart valves, all at moderate or high risk of bias.
evidence_base.quote: Of the 30 studies (1373 pregnancies) that reported the use of VKAs throughout pregnancy, 11 (581 pregnancies) used a standard INR target of 2.5–3.5
evidence_base.source_label: D'Souza et al., Anticoagulation for pregnant women with mechanical heart valves: a systematic review and meta-analysis, Eur Heart J 2017;38(19):1509-1516 (Results)

window.text: Malformations were described mostly after exposure between 6 and 9 weeks of pregnancy, counted from the first day of the last period (weeks of amenorrhoea).
window.quote: un syndrome malformatif a été décrit dans environ 4 % à 7 % des grossesses exposées le plus souvent entre 6 et 9 semaines d'aménorrhée.
window.source_label: ANSM, Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit, SINTROM 4 mg (acénocoumarol), section 4.6, updated 20/06/2025

dose.text: A systematic review cites registry data that did not show reduced foetal loss with low first-trimester doses of vitamin K antagonists, low meaning 2 mg a day or less for acenocoumarol.
dose.quote: recent data from the Registry of Pregnancy and Cardiac disease (ROPAC) registry did not demonstrate reduced foetal loss with the use of low first-trimester doses of VKAs [warfarin ≤5 mg/day, acenocoumarol ≤2 mg/day or phenprocoumon ≤3 mg/day)]
dose.source_label: D'Souza et al., Anticoagulation for pregnant women with mechanical heart valves: a systematic review and meta-analysis, Eur Heart J 2017;38(19):1509-1516 (Discussion, citing van Hagen 2015 ROPAC)

effects.text: ENTIS experts list multiple malformations including an underdeveloped nose, stippled bone ends, skeletal and finger or toe (digital) defects, with reduced growth and facial differences.
effects.quote: Multiple malformations including nasal hypoplasia, stippled epiphyses, skeletal and digital. Growth disruption. Facial dysmorphia.
effects.source_label: ENTIS consensus, Bluett-Duncan et al., Birth Defects Res 2025;117(9):e2497, Table 1 (acenocoumarol row; the cell also covers phenindione and warfarin)

absolute_risk.text: The French label states that, with vitamin K antagonists including Sintrom, a malformation syndrome has been described in about 4% to 7% of exposed pregnancies, and gives no comparison rate.
absolute_risk.quote: un syndrome malformatif a été décrit dans environ 4 % à 7 % des grossesses exposées le plus souvent entre 6 et 9 semaines d'aménorrhée.
absolute_risk.source_label: ANSM, Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit, SINTROM 4 mg (acénocoumarol), section 4.6, updated 20/06/2025

before_after.text: The French Sintrom label says women of childbearing age must be told to use effective contraception during treatment and until 3 days after stopping, and to plan pregnancies to allow a safer alternative.
before_after.quote: de la nécessité d’utiliser une contraception efficace pendant le traitement et jusqu’à 3 jours après l’arrêt de celui-ci et d’anticiper un projet de grossesse afin de permettre le relais par une alternative thérapeutique plus sûre
before_after.source_label: ANSM, Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit, SINTROM 4 mg (acénocoumarol), sections 4.4 and 4.6, updated 20/06/2025

other_effects.text: The French Sintrom label states that cerebral fetopathy, mainly central nervous system and eye anomalies, occurs in 1 to 2% of vitamin K antagonist exposures beyond 9 weeks of amenorrhoea.
other_effects.quote: une fœtopathie cérébrale survient dans 1 à 2 % des cas d’exposition au-delà de 9 semaines d'aménorrhée
other_effects.source_label: ANSM, Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit, SINTROM 4 mg (acénocoumarol), section 4.6 (class passage on vitamin K antagonists), updated 20/06/2025

regulatory.text: ANSM's December 2018 letter announced that vitamin K antagonists, including acenocoumarol, are contraindicated in pregnancy, except for women with a mechanical heart valve at high thromboembolic risk whose potential benefits outweigh the risks.
regulatory.quote: l’utilisation des antivitamines K est désormais contre-indiquée au cours de la grossesse, sauf chez les femmes enceintes portant une valve cardiaque mécanique qui présentent un risque thromboembolique élevé
regulatory.source_label: ANSM, Lettre aux professionnels de santé, Traitement par antivitamines K (AVK) : nouvelles informations (COUMADINE, PREVISCAN, SINTROM, MINISINTROM), 1 December 2018

monitoring.text: If Sintrom is used in pregnancy or pregnancy is discovered on treatment, the French label requires specialised prenatal diagnosis by ultrasound, or even MRI, adapted to the period of exposure.
monitoring.quote: la patiente doit être pleinement informée des risques pour le fœtus et un diagnostic prénatal spécialisé (échographique voire IRM) adapté en fonction de la période d'exposition doit être instauré
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit, SINTROM 4 mg (acénocoumarol), section 4.6, updated 20/06/2025

evidence_base.text: A multicentre prospective ENTIS cohort (1988–2004) followed 226 acenocoumarol-exposed pregnancies among 666 vitamin K antagonist exposures and 1,094 unexposed controls; its abstract reports results for the class as a whole.
evidence_base.quote: we compared 666 pregnant women exposed to phenprocoumon (n = 280), acenocoumarol (n = 226), fluindione (n = 99), warfarin (n = 63) and phenindione (n = 2) to a non-exposed control group (n = 1,094)
evidence_base.source_label: Schaefer C et al., Vitamin K antagonists and pregnancy outcome. A multi-centre prospective study, Thromb Haemost 2006;95(6):949-57, PubMed abstract

window.text: In an ENTIS multicentre cohort of vitamin K antagonist exposures (only 2 with phenindione), coumarin embryopathy risk was very small, especially when first-trimester therapy stopped by week 8, counted from the last menstrual period.
window.quote: The risk for coumarin embryopathy is, however, very small, in particular when therapy during the 1(st) trimester did not take place later than week 8 after the 1(st) day of the last menstrual period.
window.source_label: Schaefer C et al. Vitamin K antagonists and pregnancy outcome. A multi-centre prospective study (ENTIS, 666 exposed vs 1,094 controls). Thromb Haemost 2006;95(6):949-57, PubMed abstract

effects.text: The ENTIS consensus lists, for the anticoagulant group including phenindione, multiple malformations including nasal hypoplasia, stippled epiphyses, skeletal and digital (finger or toe) defects, growth disruption and facial dysmorphia.
effects.quote: Multiple malformations including nasal hypoplasia, stippled epiphyses, skeletal and digital. Growth disruption. Facial dysmorphia.
effects.source_label: Bluett-Duncan M et al. ENTIS expert consensus, Birth Defects Res 2025;117(9):e2497, Table 1, anticoagulant row (one cell spanning acenocoumarol, phenindione, warfarin)

absolute_risk.text: A meta-analysis in women with mechanical heart valves, counting phenindione among vitamin K antagonists, found anticoagulant-related embryopathy or fetopathy in about 2% of fetuses exposed to them throughout pregnancy at standard INR targets.
absolute_risk.quote: Anticoagulant-related embryopathy and foetopathy was seen in approximately 2% of the foetuses exposed to VKAs throughout pregnancy.
absolute_risk.source_label: D'Souza R et al. Anticoagulation for pregnant women with mechanical heart valves: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Eur Heart J 2017;38(19):1509-1516, open-access full text, Results and Table 1 (vitamin K antagonists, INR target 2.5-3.5, 12/407)

before_after.text: The UK label says women of child-bearing age treated with phenindione should be cautioned about possible pregnancy complications; it sets no contraception duration, washout period or pregnancy test.
before_after.quote: Women of child-bearing age who are treated with Dindevan should be cautioned about the possible complications of pregnancy.
before_after.source_label: UK Summary of Product Characteristics, Dindevan 25mg Tablets / Phenindione 25mg Tablets (Mercury Pharma Group / ADVANZ Pharma), section 4.6, date of revision 19/02/2024, on emc

other_effects.text: In women with mechanical heart valves, a meta-analysis counting phenindione among vitamin K antagonists found a 1.4% fetopathy risk (central nervous system or eye abnormalities) from second- and third-trimester exposure after first-trimester heparin.
other_effects.quote: Also, although sequential treatment eliminates the risk of anticoagulant-related embryopathy, the risk of anticoagulant-related foetopathy from second- and third-trimester exposure is 1.4%.
other_effects.source_label: D'Souza R et al. Anticoagulation for pregnant women with mechanical heart valves: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Eur Heart J 2017;38(19):1509-1516, open-access full text, Discussion

regulatory.text: The UK phenindione label contraindicates oral anticoagulant therapy in pregnancy because of possible teratogenicity and the risk of fetal haemorrhage near term.
regulatory.quote: Oral anticoagulant therapy is contraindicated in pregnancy because of possible teratogenicity and the risk of foetal haemorrhage near term.
regulatory.source_label: UK Summary of Product Characteristics, Dindevan 25mg Tablets / Phenindione 25mg Tablets (Mercury Pharma Group / ADVANZ Pharma), sections 4.3 and 4.6, date of revision 19/02/2024, on emc

monitoring.text: An ENTIS multicentre cohort study recommends close obstetric follow-up, including a level II (detailed) ultrasound scan, after any vitamin K antagonist exposure during pregnancy, a class that includes phenindione.
monitoring.quote: Close follow-up by the obstetrician including level II ultrasound should be recommended in any case of VKA exposure during pregnancy.
monitoring.source_label: Schaefer C et al. Vitamin K antagonists and pregnancy outcome. A multi-centre prospective study (ENTIS, 12 centres). Thromb Haemost 2006;95(6):949-57, PubMed abstract

evidence_base.text: An ENTIS multicentre prospective study compared 666 pregnant women exposed to vitamin K antagonists, including 2 exposed to phenindione, with a non-exposed control group of 1,094 women.
evidence_base.quote: we compared 666 pregnant women exposed to phenprocoumon (n = 280), acenocoumarol (n = 226), fluindione (n = 99), warfarin (n = 63) and phenindione (n = 2) to a non-exposed control group (n = 1,094).
evidence_base.source_label: Schaefer C et al. Vitamin K antagonists and pregnancy outcome. A multi-centre prospective study (ENTIS, 12 centres). Thromb Haemost 2006;95(6):949-57, PubMed abstract

window.text: In US cohorts of DES-exposed sons, undescended testis, epididymal cysts and testicular inflammation were more strongly associated with exposure before the 11th week of gestation, though timing could not be definitively separated from dose.
window.quote: Because nearly all women who receive a cumulative dose of 5 grams or greater had begun taking DES before the 11th week of gestation, it was not possible to determine definitively which of these factors was more important.
window.source_label: Palmer JR et al. Urogenital abnormalities in men exposed to diethylstilbestrol in utero: a cohort study (three pooled US cohorts, 1,197 exposed, 1,038 unexposed). Environ Health 2009;8:37, open-access full text, Results (Table 2) and Discussion

dose.text: In the US DESAD cohort, cervical and vaginal structural anomalies in daughters were closely associated with the total DES dose and the gestational week of first exposure; the abstract gives no threshold.
dose.quote: Among the 367 cases found by record review to have complete information on the DES exposure, multivariate analysis indicated close association of the anomalies with the gestational week of first exposure and the total dose.
dose.source_label: Jefferies JA et al. Structural anomalies of the cervix and vagina in women enrolled in the Diethylstilbestrol Adenosis (DESAD) Project. Am J Obstet Gynecol 1984;148(1):59-66, PubMed abstract

effects.text: US FDA-approved estrogen labelling states that DES-exposed daughters have increased risks of vaginal adenosis, cervical squamous dysplasia and clear-cell vaginal cancer later in life, and sons of urogenital abnormalities and possibly testicular cancer.
effects.quote: female offspring have an increased risk of vaginal adenosis, squamous cell dysplasia of the uterine cervix, and clear cell vaginal cancer later in life; male offspring have an increased risk of urogenital abnormalities and possibly testicular cancer
effects.source_label: US FDA-approved labeling (ANDA040312), Innofem estradiol tablets USP, boxed warning on estrogens in pregnancy, DailyMed, revised 4/2017 (product marketing ended 2009)

absolute_risk.text: In the US DESAD cohort, structural anomalies of the cervix or vagina were found in 25% of 1,655 DES-exposed daughters identified from prenatal records, versus 2% of 963 control subjects.
absolute_risk.quote: 25% of the 1,655 subjects identified by review of prenatal records, 43% of the 800 who themselves requested entry into the project, and 49% of the 1,089 referred by physicians but in only 2% of the 963 control subjects.
absolute_risk.source_label: Jefferies JA et al. Structural anomalies of the cervix and vagina in women enrolled in the Diethylstilbestrol Adenosis (DESAD) Project. Am J Obstet Gynecol 1984;148(1):59-66, PubMed abstract

paternal.text: France's medicines agency states that, to date, no consequences have been shown in children whose fathers were themselves exposed to DES before birth.
paternal.quote: À ce jour, il n’a pas été mis en évidence de conséquences chez les enfants de pères exposés in utero au DES.
paternal.source_label: ANSM (French medicines agency), dossier thématique 'Diéthylstilbestrol (DES) et grossesse', published 20/07/2026, updated 21/07/2026

other_effects.text: Women exposed to DES before birth had higher cumulative risks than unexposed women of infertility (33.3% vs 15.5%), spontaneous abortion (50.3% vs 38.6%) and preterm delivery (53.3% vs 17.8%), assessed to age 45.
other_effects.quote: for infertility, 33.3% vs. 15.5% (hazard ratio, 2.37; 95% confidence interval [CI], 2.05 to 2.75); spontaneous abortion, 50.3% vs. 38.6% (hazard ratio, 1.64; 95% CI, 1.42 to 1.88); preterm delivery, 53.3% vs. 17.8%
other_effects.source_label: Hoover RN et al. Adverse health outcomes in women exposed in utero to diethylstilbestrol (three pooled studies initiated in the 1970s). N Engl J Med 2011;365(14):1304-14, PubMed abstract, Results

regulatory.text: In France, the indication for recurrent spontaneous miscarriage was removed in 1976 and a contraindication for use in pregnant women was added in 1977.
regulatory.quote: En France, l’indication " avortements spontanés à répétition " a été supprimée en 1976 et la contre-indication d’utilisation chez la femme enceinte a été ajoutée en 1977.
regulatory.source_label: Afssaps (now ANSM), Mise au point 'Complications liées à l’exposition in utero au diéthylstilbestrol (DES)', Actualisation 2011 (June 2011), Historique

monitoring.text: For women exposed to DES before birth, France's medicines agency recommends reinforced gynaecological follow-up for dysplasia, adenosis and adenocarcinoma, plus breast cancer screening as recommended for their age.
monitoring.quote: Suivi gynécologique renforcé (dysplasie, adénose, adénocarcinome). Dépistage du cancer du sein selon les recommandations pour cette tranche d’âge.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM (French medicines agency), dossier thématique 'Diéthylstilbestrol (DES) et grossesse', section Pour les professionnels de santé, Prise en charge, 2e génération, published 20/07/2026, updated 21/07/2026

evidence_base.text: Human evidence includes the pooled long-term follow-up of three studies started in the 1970s, covering 4,653 women exposed to DES before birth and 1,927 unexposed controls.
evidence_base.quote: We combined data from three studies initiated in the 1970s with continued long-term follow-up of 4653 women exposed in utero to DES and 1927 unexposed controls.
evidence_base.source_label: Hoover RN et al. Adverse health outcomes in women exposed in utero to diethylstilbestrol (three pooled studies initiated in the 1970s). N Engl J Med 2011;365(14):1304-14, PubMed abstract, Methods

window.text: EU product information says carbimazole is suspected to cause malformations when used in pregnancy, particularly in the first trimester; it counts by trimester and gives no week range.
window.quote: Based on human experience from epidemiological studies and spontaneous reporting, carbimazole is suspected to cause congenital malformations when administered during pregnancy, particularly in the first trimester of pregnancy and at high doses.
window.source_label: EMA PRAC, New product information wording, carbimazole SmPC 4.6 (EPITT 19238), adopted 26-29 November 2018

dose.text: The UK medicines regulator says carbimazole is associated with an increased malformation risk, particularly at high doses, which it defines as 15 mg or more daily.
dose.quote: carbimazole is associated with an increased risk of congenital malformations when used during pregnancy, particularly in the first trimester of pregnancy and at high doses (15 mg or more of carbimazole daily)
dose.source_label: MHRA Drug Safety Update, volume 12, issue 7, February 2019 (carbimazole: increased risk of congenital malformations)
dose.id: MHRA Drug Safety Update vol 12 issue 7

effects.text: EU product information reports malformations including a missing patch of skin (aplasia cutis), choanal atresia, facial dysmorphism, exomphalos, oesophageal atresia, omphalomesenteric duct anomaly and ventricular septal defect, naming no limb defects.
effects.quote: Reported malformations include aplasia cutis congenita, craniofacial malformations (choanal atresia; facial dysmorphism), exomphalos, oesophageal atresia, omphalo-mesenteric duct anomaly, and ventricular septal defect.
effects.source_label: EMA PRAC, New product information wording, carbimazole SmPC 4.6 (EPITT 19238)

absolute_risk.text: In a Danish nationwide register, 9.6% of children exposed to methimazole or carbimazole in early pregnancy had a birth defect diagnosed before age 2, versus 6.7% of unexposed children.
absolute_risk.quote: The overall frequency of birth defects was 6.7% (95% CI, 6.7% to 6.8%) in nonexposed children and higher after exposure to methimazole/carbimazole (9.6%; 95% CI, 8.2% to 11.2%)
absolute_risk.source_label: Andersen SL et al. Maternal thyroid function, use of antithyroid drugs in early pregnancy, and birth defects. J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2019;104(12):6040-6048 (abstract)

before_after.text: EU product information tells women who could become pregnant to use reliable contraception from the start of carbimazole treatment and during it, and sets no period after stopping.
before_after.quote: If you could get pregnant, use reliable contraception from the time you start treatment and during treatment.
before_after.source_label: EMA PRAC, New product information wording, carbimazole package leaflet section 2 (EPITT 19238), adopted 26-29 November 2018

other_effects.text: New Zealand product information says transient thyroid function abnormalities have been reported in newborns whose mothers took carbimazole (Neo-Mercazole) during pregnancy.
other_effects.quote: Transient thyroid function abnormalities have been reported in new-borns born to mothers treated with Neo-Mercazole during pregnancy.
other_effects.source_label: Medsafe (New Zealand regulator), Neo-Mercazole (carbimazole) New Zealand Data Sheet, section 4.6, revised 10 December 2020

regulatory.text: Under the 2018 EU wording, carbimazole may be given in pregnancy only after a strict individual benefit-risk assessment, at the lowest effective dose and without added thyroid hormones.
regulatory.quote: Carbimazole must only be administered during pregnancy after a strict individual benefit/risk assessment and only at the lowest effective dose without additional administration of thyroid hormones.
regulatory.source_label: EMA PRAC, New product information wording, carbimazole SmPC 4.6 (EPITT 19238), adopted 26-29 November 2018

monitoring.text: New Zealand product information says a prenatal ultrasound should be considered to detect some of the malformations it lists and to monitor the fetal thyroid, and a neonatal thyroid function test should be performed.
monitoring.quote: A prenatal exam (ultrasound) should be considered in order to detect some of the above-cited malformations and to monitor the foetal thyroid gland. A neonatal thyroid function test should be performed.
monitoring.source_label: Medsafe (New Zealand regulator), Neo-Mercazole (carbimazole) New Zealand Data Sheet, section 4.6, revised 10 December 2020

evidence_base.text: A 2022 systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 cohort studies counted 5,957 pregnancy exposures to carbimazole or methimazole, analysed together rather than drug by drug.
evidence_base.quote: We identified 16 cohort studies comprising 5957, 15,785, and 15,666 exposures to CMZ/MMI, PTU, and untreated hyperthyroidism, respectively.
evidence_base.source_label: Agrawal M et al. Antithyroid drug therapy in pregnancy and risk of congenital anomalies: systematic review and meta-analysis. Clin Endocrinol (Oxf) 2022;96(6):857-868 (abstract)

window.text: The US label states methimazole can cause fetal harm when given in the first trimester; it counts by trimester and gives no week range.
window.quote: Methimazole crosses the placental membranes and can cause fetal harm when administered in the first trimester of pregnancy.
window.source_label: US FDA label, methimazole tablets, WARNINGS (First Trimester Use of Methimazole and Congenital Malformations), via openFDA

dose.text: In a Korean nationwide cohort, a first-trimester cumulative methimazole dose above 495 mg was associated with higher malformation risk than a low cumulative dose of 1 to 126 mg.
dose.quote: In the MMI group, a high cumulative dose (>495 mg) during the first trimester was associated with an increased risk for malformations compared with a low dose (1 to 126 mg)
dose.source_label: Seo GH, Kim TH, Chung JH. Antithyroid drugs and congenital malformations: a nationwide Korean cohort study. Ann Intern Med 2018;168(6):405-413 (abstract)

effects.text: EU product information for thiamazole (methimazole) reports malformations including a missing patch of skin (aplasia cutis), choanal atresia, facial dysmorphism, exomphalos, oesophageal atresia, omphalomesenteric duct anomaly and ventricular septal defect, naming no limb defects.
effects.quote: Reported malformations include aplasia cutis congenita, craniofacial malformations (choanal atresia; facial dysmorphism), exomphalos, oesophageal atresia, omphalo-mesenteric duct anomaly, and ventricular septal defect.
effects.source_label: EMA PRAC, New product information wording, thiamazole (synonym: methimazole) SmPC 4.6 (EPITT 19238)

absolute_risk.text: In a Danish nationwide register, 9.6% of children exposed to methimazole or carbimazole in early pregnancy had a birth defect diagnosed before age 2, versus 6.7% of unexposed children.
absolute_risk.quote: The overall frequency of birth defects was 6.7% (95% CI, 6.7% to 6.8%) in nonexposed children and higher after exposure to methimazole/carbimazole (9.6%; 95% CI, 8.2% to 11.2%)
absolute_risk.source_label: Andersen SL et al. Maternal thyroid function, use of antithyroid drugs in early pregnancy, and birth defects. J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2019;104(12):6040-6048 (abstract)

before_after.text: Canada's methimazole monograph says women of childbearing potential should use effective contraception during methimazole therapy, and it gives no period after stopping and no pregnancy test.
before_after.quote: Women of childbearing potential should use effective methods of contraception during methimazole therapy.
before_after.source_label: Health Canada, TAPAZOLE (methimazole tablets) Product Monograph, section 7.1.1 Pregnant Women, revised 19 December 2025

other_effects.text: Canada's monograph says methimazole readily crosses the placenta and can induce goitre and hypothyroidism in the developing fetus.
other_effects.quote: Methimazole readily crosses the placental membranes and can induce goiter and hypothyroidism in the developing fetus.
other_effects.source_label: Health Canada, TAPAZOLE (methimazole tablets) Product Monograph, section 7.1.1 Pregnant Women, revised 19 December 2025

regulatory.text: French product information for thiamazole (Thyrozol) contraindicates treatment combining thiamazole with thyroid hormones during pregnancy, and its contraindications section lists no other pregnancy contraindication.
regulatory.quote: Un traitement associant le thiamazole et des hormones thyroïdiennes est contre-indiqué pendant la grossesse (voir rubrique 4.6).
regulatory.source_label: ANSM, base de données publique des médicaments, THYROZOL 10 mg (thiamazole) RCP section 4.3, page updated 11/04/2023

monitoring.text: Canada's monograph recommends close maternal, fetal and neonatal monitoring when methimazole is used in pregnancy, with the methimazole dose adjusted as necessary.
monitoring.quote: Close maternal, fetal, and neonatal monitoring is recommended, with adjustment of methimazole as necessary.
monitoring.source_label: Health Canada, TAPAZOLE (methimazole tablets) Product Monograph, section 7.1.1 Pregnant Women, revised 19 December 2025

evidence_base.text: A 2022 systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 cohort studies counted 5,957 pregnancy exposures to carbimazole or methimazole, analysed together rather than drug by drug.
evidence_base.quote: We identified 16 cohort studies comprising 5957, 15,785, and 15,666 exposures to CMZ/MMI, PTU, and untreated hyperthyroidism, respectively.
evidence_base.source_label: Agrawal M et al. Antithyroid drug therapy in pregnancy and risk of congenital anomalies: systematic review and meta-analysis. Clin Endocrinol (Oxf) 2022;96(6):857-868 (abstract)

window.text: The US label states that methotrexate exposure in the first trimester, counted by trimester of pregnancy, is associated with more miscarriages and multiple developmental problems.
window.quote: Methotrexate exposure during the first trimester of pregnancy is associated with an increased incidence of spontaneous abortions and multiple adverse developmental outcomes
window.source_label: US FDA label, Trexall (methotrexate) tablets, section 8.1 Pregnancy (read via openFDA)

dose.text: The EMA says data are insufficient for exposure in pregnancy above 30 mg a week, but higher rates of miscarriage and malformations are expected, particularly at doses used to treat cancer.
dose.quote: Insufficient data is available for methotrexate exposure during pregnancy higher than 30 mg (15 ml)/week, but higher rates of spontaneous abortions and congenital malformations are expected, in particular at doses commonly used in oncologic indications
dose.source_label: EMA, Jylamvo (methotrexate) EPAR product information, SmPC section 4.6

effects.text: First-trimester exposure is associated with skull, facial, central nervous system and limb abnormalities (limb defects flagged), and sometimes heart defects and intellectual impairment.
effects.quote: multiple adverse developmental outcomes, including skull anomalies, facial dysmorphism, central nervous system abnormalities, limb abnormalities, and sometimes cardiac anomalies and intellectual impairment
effects.source_label: US FDA label, Trexall (methotrexate) tablets, section 8.1 Pregnancy (read via openFDA)

absolute_risk.text: Major birth defects occurred in 6.6% of babies born alive after low-dose methotrexate in pregnancy, compared with about 4% of babies born alive to women with the same diseases on other medicines.
absolute_risk.quote: Major birth defects occurred in 6.6% of live births in women exposed to low-dose methotrexate treatment (less than 30 mg [15 ml]/week) during pregnancy, compared to approximately 4% of live births in disease-matched patients
absolute_risk.source_label: EMA, Jylamvo (methotrexate) EPAR product information, SmPC section 4.6

before_after.text: The EU product information requires pregnancy to be excluded before use in non-cancer indications, and effective contraception in women of childbearing potential during treatment and for at least six months after.
before_after.quote: In non-oncologic indications, the absence of pregnancy must be confirmed before Jylamvo is used. If women of child bearing potential are treated, effective contraception must be used during treatment and for at least six months after.
before_after.source_label: EMA, Jylamvo (methotrexate) EPAR product information, SmPC section 4.4 (Teratogenicity – Reproductive risk)

paternal.text: As a precaution, the EU product information recommends reliable contraception for sexually active treated men or their female partners until at least 3 months after stopping, and no semen donation until 3 months after.
paternal.quote: recommended to use reliable contraception during treatment of the male patient and for at least 3 months after cessation of methotrexate. Men should not donate semen during therapy or for 3 months following discontinuation of methotrexate.
paternal.source_label: EMA, Jylamvo (methotrexate) EPAR product information, SmPC section 4.6 (Contraception in males)

other_effects.text: The US label states that exposure in the second and third trimesters is associated with intrauterine growth restriction and functional abnormalities.
other_effects.quote: Adverse outcomes associated with exposure during second and third trimesters of pregnancy include intrauterine growth restriction and functional abnormalities.
other_effects.source_label: US FDA label, Trexall (methotrexate) tablets, section 8.1 Pregnancy (read via openFDA)

regulatory.text: The US label carries a boxed warning that methotrexate tablets can cause embryo-fetal toxicity, including fetal death, and contraindicates them in pregnancy for non-cancer diseases.
regulatory.quote: WARNING: EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY, HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS, SEVERE ADVERSE REACTIONS, AND RISK OF MEDICATION ERRORS Methotrexate tablets can cause embryo-fetal toxicity, including fetal death. For non-neoplastic diseases, methotrexate tablets are contraindicated in pregnancy.
regulatory.source_label: US FDA label, Trexall (methotrexate) tablets, Boxed Warning (read via openFDA)

monitoring.text: If pregnancy occurs during treatment or up to six months after, the EU product information says to give medical advice on the risk to the child and to perform ultrasound examinations.
monitoring.quote: If pregnancy occurs during treatment with methotrexate and up to six months thereafter, medical advice should be given regarding the risk of harmful effects on the child associated with treatment and ultrasonography examinations should be performed
monitoring.source_label: EMA, Jylamvo (methotrexate) EPAR product information, SmPC section 4.6 (Pregnancy)

evidence_base.text: A prospective multicentre cohort study included 324 pregnancies exposed to methotrexate at 30 mg/week or less, 188 after conception and 136 in the 12 weeks before, plus 459 disease-matched and 1,107 non-autoimmune comparison women.
evidence_base.quote: The study sample included 324 MTX-exposed pregnancies (188 exposed post-conception, 136 exposed pre-conception), 459 disease-matched comparison women, and 1,107 comparison women without autoimmune diseases.
evidence_base.source_label: Weber-Schoendorfer C et al., Arthritis Rheumatol 2014;66(5):1101-10, prospective multicenter cohort (PubMed abstract)

effects.text: ENTIS lists multiple malformations for methotrexate and aminopterin together, including skeletal, heart and urogenital defects and holoprosencephaly (a brain malformation), plus growth disruption; limbs are not named separately.
effects.quote: Multiple malformations including skeletal, cardiovascular, urogenital, holoprosencephaly. Growth disruption.
effects.source_label: Bluett-Duncan et al., ENTIS expert consensus, Birth Defects Res 2025;117(9):e2497, Table 1 (row 'Methotrexate and Aminopterin')

other_effects.text: ENTIS lists growth disruption besides multiple malformations in its joint entry for methotrexate and aminopterin, so the entry is not specific to aminopterin.
other_effects.quote: Multiple malformations including skeletal, cardiovascular, urogenital, holoprosencephaly. Growth disruption.
other_effects.source_label: Bluett-Duncan et al., ConcePTION scoping review with ENTIS expert-panel list of teratogens, Birth Defects Res 2025;117(9):e2497, Table 1 (row 'Methotrexate and Aminopterin')

evidence_base.text: A scoping review using the ENTIS expert list found 7 case series or reports and no empirical cohort on neurodevelopment after methotrexate or aminopterin, which it counts together.
evidence_base.quote: Structural teratogens included in this review and the number of case series/reports and empirical cohorts identified.
evidence_base.source_label: Bluett-Duncan et al., ConcePTION scoping review with ENTIS expert-panel list of teratogens, Birth Defects Res 2025;117(9):e2497, Table 1 caption; row 'Methotrexate and Aminopterin' gives 7 case series/reports and 0 empirical cohorts

window.text: The US label says use during pregnancy is associated with higher risks of first-trimester pregnancy loss and of malformations, and it names no narrower window for the malformations.
window.quote: Use during pregnancy is associated with increased risks of first trimester pregnancy loss and congenital malformations.
window.source_label: US FDA label, CellCept (Genentech), Boxed Warning (Embryofetal toxicity), read via openFDA, version 51, effective 2026-08-05

dose.text: In rats and rabbits, mycophenolate caused malformations and pregnancy loss at doses below the recommended human clinical dose; this is an animal finding, not a human threshold.
dose.quote: Oral administration of mycophenolate to rats and rabbits during the period of organogenesis produced congenital malformations and pregnancy loss at doses less than the recommended clinical dose
dose.source_label: US FDA label, CellCept (Genentech), section 8.1 Pregnancy, read via openFDA, version 51 (DailyMed version 51 published 2026-08-10)

effects.text: Documented malformations include anomalies of the distal limbs (a limb defect), defects of the outer ear, eye and face such as cleft lip and palate, and heart, oesophagus, kidney and nervous system defects.
effects.quote: Malformations that have been documented include external ear, eye, and other facial abnormalities including cleft lip and palate, and anomalies of the distal limbs, heart, esophagus, kidney, and nervous system.
effects.source_label: US FDA label, CellCept (Genentech), section 8.1 Pregnancy, Human Data

absolute_risk.text: EMA reports malformations in 23 to 27% of babies exposed during pregnancy, against 4 to 5% in transplant patients on other immunosuppressants and 2 to 3% in the overall population.
